name: Fana De La Wibell Leyendike
original_name: ファナ=デ・ラ・ウィーヴェル・ライエンダイク
source:
Star Sign: Leo
Image Plant: Rose, Rosemary

A wealthy girl who hates warped people.
The type who has to be first at everything and will put all her effort into it no matter the means.
The daughter of a noble that was ejected from being a cabinet minister.
